benchmarks.description: Compare fourteen product paths by single-core server throughput or cold-navigation browser cost without collapsing unlike measurements into one score.
benchmarks.methodology: 100 todos · 12 component types · 32 warm structural variants · current UTC state materialized per request · 64 connections from 2 load workers · 1 server process/worker pinned to 1 CPU · 7 × 10 s randomized rounds · dynamic SSR · natural bytes
benchmarks.metricSummary: React records the highest median, 8.7% ahead of WebUI / FAST V3 / Rust / Actix; the 43.7 req/s gap exceeds their combined 42.9 req/s MAD.
